question: Which state is in the news for achieving full functional literacy in May 2025?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Mizoram**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mizoram** has achieved full functional literacy, setting an example for other states in India.
 
• Functional literacy is defined as the ability to use reading, writing, and mathematical skills for practical and meaningful purposes.
 
• The state achieved this milestone through various **government-driven literacy programs** and **community participation**.
 
• Mizoram has been known for its strong focus on **education**, with the literacy rate already being among the highest in the country.
 
• The state implemented innovative initiatives such as **adult literacy campaigns**, **skill-based learning workshops**, and **collaboration with NGOs**.
 
• According to the **2021 Census**, Mizoram had a high literacy rate which has now transitioned into functional literacy for all its citizens.
 
• The achievement is a result of the state’s commitment to **Sustainable Development Goals (SDG)**, particularly Goal 4 which emphasizes quality education.
 
• Mizoram’s success highlights the importance of integrating educational policies with **local needs** and leveraging community efforts to drive literacy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Tripura**__

 __
 
• **Tripura**, located in the northeastern part of India, is known for its **rich cultural heritage**.
 
• The state has a high literacy rate and significant progress in education, but it has not yet achieved full functional literacy.
 
• Tripura is famous for its **tribal communities** and their contribution to the state's cultural diversity.
 
 
 
• **Nagaland**__
 __
 
• **Nagaland** is another northeastern state known for its **unique traditions and festivals**.
 
• The state has a good literacy rate but has not claimed to achieve functional literacy yet.
 
• Nagaland is recognized for its efforts in preserving its **indigenous languages and culture**.
 
 
 
• **Meghalaya**__
 
 
• **Meghalaya**, also located in northeast India, is renowned for its **natural beauty** and **biodiversity**.
 
• While literacy programs have been implemented, the state has not yet reached full functional literacy.
 
• Meghalaya is known for its **living root bridges** and **eco-friendly practices**.
